definitions.documentation: Keycloak Remove User From Group. DELETE /admin/realms/{realm}/users/{userId}/groups/{groupId}. Requires config.confirmWrites=true and confirmation=KEYCLOAK LEAVE-GROUP. Exactly one request, no retries; bounded page (default max=100, maximum=500 where pagination exists), 1 MiB response and total deadline including connection lookup and cleanup. RuntimeConnection uses config.baseUrl/config.realm and credentials.accessToken; alternatively config.tokenSecret resolves a protected secret. HTTPS canonical baseUrl is explicit and fixed for this execution; optional HTTP requires allowInsecureHttp=true and insecureHttpAcknowledgement=KEYCLOAK LAN HTTP. IDs are exact route fragments (clientId means internal client UUID, realm means realm NAME); unsafe dot/escaped/slashed identities rejected before credentials. Only allowlisted metadata fields are emitted; credential/config/attribute blobs are omitted. No token issuance, email action, credential reset, secret generation, arbitrary proxy or returned-link traversal.
